category_edits.rationale: Blend each current GRU state with its causal, padding-masked exponential pooled state: 80% current state and 20% pooled history with a five-interaction half-life. Training and inference share this readout because the generated predictor imports GRU4RecModel from train.py. Preserve the backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, and per-category checkpoints.

change_summary: Implement the specified 80/20 recurrent-state readout for all four category models, consistently across causal training prefixes and prediction.
